text:
Ottinger Architects specializes in urban in-fill projects of varying scales throughout the Los Angeles region. Our practice focuses on mixed-use, market-rate and affordable housing. We offer a collaborative work environment and the opportunity to be involved in all facets of a project, from initial design through construction.
We are seeking an experienced, highly motivated Project Architect with strong design sensibilities, technical capabilities, and excellent communication and interpersonal skills. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of projects while working collaboratively with clients, consultants, and internal team members.
We promote a collaborative environment that encourages involvement in all aspects of a project, providing opportunities to contribute to both the creative and technical aspects of architecture.
We offer a hybrid work schedule, with four days in the office and one day working remotely each week. In-person collaboration is an important part of our office culture, including regular design meetings and coordination with the principal and team members.
Position Overview
The position will initially focus on leading construction administration for an active multifamily residential project, serving as the primary architectural point of contact throughout construction. Over time, the role will expand into broader Project Architect responsibilities across the firm's portfolio, with involvement in design development, technical coordination, drawing production, and project delivery. We are looking for someone who is equally comfortable managing the construction process and contributing to the design and documentation of buildings.
Role Responsibilities:
Lead and manage construction administration for an active multifamily residential project, serving as the primary architectural point of contact with the general contractor, consultants, and owner.
Manage the day-to-day CA process, including reviewing shop drawings and submittals, responding to RFIs, preparing ASIs and clarifications, and conducting site visits.
Coordinate with the project team to resolve construction-related issues and maintain project schedules and deliverables.
Qualifications:
Professional degree in Architecture.
10–15 years of professional experience in an architectural firm.
Licensed architect preferred.
Experience managing construction administration for multifamily residential and/or mixed-use projects.
Demonstrated experience coordinating with general contractors, reviewing shop drawings and submittals, responding to RFIs, preparing ASIs, and conducting construction site visits.
Strong understanding of building construction, detailing, construction methods, building codes, and accessibility requirements, including Type I, III, and V construction.
Strong design sensibility and the ability to translate design concepts into well-resolved architectural drawings.
Advanced proficiency in Revit, including model development, drawing production, and construction documentation.
Proficiency in Bluebeam and digital construction administration workflows.
Experience coordinating structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other consultant drawings.
Familiarity with Los Angeles and Santa Monica zoning and entitlement processes is a plus.
Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
Ability to provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members.
Benefits:
Full medical, dental, and vision coverage.
401(k) with a 3% annual employer contribution once eligible.
Three weeks of paid time off annually, including 11 days of individual vacation and 4 additional paid days during our year-end office closure.
8 paid holidays.
Paid sick leave.
Hybrid work environment (four days in the office, one day remote) with the possibility of a flexible schedule.
Bonus opportunities.
Application Instructions:
Please email a cover letter, resume and work samples in PDF format to: [email protected] and indicate "Project Architect" in the subject line.
